[1/1] Graphics/effects: isolate every renderer Math.random call into a visual-only LCG so projectile sparks, flicker and particles never advance the seeded gameplay stream; prove with a failing-first RNG-consumption harness check, immediate-vs-delayed snare runs, and projectile-in-flight captures

impact_assessment.why: renderer.js calls Math.random 42 times, including per-frame projectile sparks. The render loop advances the seeded gameplay RNG, so the same seed/state can roll different trap damage depending on frame timing; before the fix the same snare took 2 vs 1 damage.
impact_assessment.benefits: Same seed/actions produce the same gameplay outcome regardless of frame timing; visual effects keep their variation; the harness's reproducibility contract holds
impact_assessment.risks: contract: renderer-local LCG plus 42 call-site replacements; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save/gameplay value change; UI: renderer.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first harness check counting Math.random calls during a projectile; immediate-vs-delayed snare play; projectile screenshots; source drift test; full gates
